headline: RBI to conduct ₹50,000 crore overnight VRRR auction on November 19, 2026
summary_points: RBI will conduct an overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on Thursday, November 19, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines in Press Release 2019-2020/1947 dated February 13, 2020 remain unchanged.

rows: As per Press Release 2019-2020/1947 dated February 13, 2020

who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants, and treasury teams tracking system liquidity and short-term rates.
action_required: Eligible participants wishing to bid should do so within the 10:30-11:00 AM window on November 19, 2026, per the 2020 operational guidelines.

social.linkedin:
RBI to conduct an overnight VRRR auction under LAF on November 19, 2026.

On a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions, the RBI has notified a Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction with the following details:

• Notified amount: ₹50,000 crore
• Tenor: 1 day
• Window: 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM on Thursday, November 19, 2026
• Reversal date: Friday, November 20, 2026

The operational guidelines issued in Press Release 2019-2020/1947 dated February 13, 2020 remain unchanged.

For treasury teams, banks and finance professionals, such operations are a useful signal of how the central bank is managing system liquidity in the short term.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1519) before acting.
